aliases.name: Doppelganger
aliases.vendor: EU DisinfoLab (operation name; overlap, not strict synonym)

identification.summary: Storm-1099 is Microsoft's designation for a Russia-linked influence actor whose activity overlaps heavily with the Doppelganger operation [S1][S2][S3]. Coverage of Microsoft's December 2023 report says Storm-1099 was behind Doppelganger, an influence operation targeting Ukraine [S1][S2]. An aggregator profile (derived from the MISP galaxy entry) describes it as conducting pro-Russia influence operations targeting international supporters of Ukraine since spring 2022 [S3]. The Doppelganger name was coined by EU DisinfoLab and reflects the operation's regular use of fake clones of legitimate media and public-institution websites [S5].
identification.firstObserved: Spring 2022 (Microsoft-derived description of activity against supporters of Ukraine) [S3].
identification.notes: Microsoft name: Storm-1099 (a 'Storm' designation for an emerging or developing cluster; this record does not cite a Microsoft statement on its graduation status). Doppelganger is the EU DisinfoLab operation name; DisinfoLab lists related operation names RRN (Recent Reliable News), Matriochka, Overload and Storm-1679 [search summary of S5]. These are separate vendor or researcher clusters and are not merged here; Microsoft tracks Storm-1679 separately.

attribution.sponsor: Russia (Microsoft describes Storm-1099 as Russia-affiliated) [S3]. For the Doppelganger operation, a September 2024 DOJ affidavit as reported by press names Social Design Agency, Structura National Technology and ANO Dialog as operating under the Russian Presidential Administration, with Sergei Kiriyenko named as directing figure [S9][S8]. EU DisinfoLab identifies Struktura and Social Design Agency (SDA/ASP) as the two companies running Doppelganger [S5].
attribution.confidence: Microsoft's confidence level for the Storm-1099 to Russia link is not stated in the sources I could read [S1][S2]. The US government statements (DOJ domain seizures, Treasury sanctions, September 2024) concern the Doppelganger operation and SDA, not Microsoft's Storm-1099 label by name; do not treat them as US government attribution of Storm-1099 as Microsoft defines it [S7][S9].
attribution.basis: Microsoft Threat Analysis Center reporting (December 2023) as relayed by press and an aggregator profile [S1][S2][S3]; DOJ affidavit and Treasury designations in September 2024 [S7][S8][S9]; EU DisinfoLab research [S5].

objectives: Reduce international support for Ukraine's defense against Russia's invasion by spreading pro-Russia, anti-Western content to audiences in supporter countries [S3][S5][S9]. In 2024 the broader Doppelganger operation was also described as aiming to influence US voters in the presidential election [S9].

sectors: General public and social media audiences in Ukraine-supporting countries
Online media consumers (clones of news outlets)
regions: Israel and the United States (recent shift as of December 2023) [S1]
Ukraine, Germany, France and the United States (Doppelganger operation) [search summary of S5]
targeting.notes: Microsoft's report, as quoted by CyberScoop, said the actor's historical target was Western Europe, especially Germany, and had recently shifted to Israel and the United States; Clint Watts said the expansion could give malign influence actors an opportunity around the 2024 US election [S1]. The targets are audiences, not networks; no network intrusion by Storm-1099 is reported in the sources I read.

capabilities.summary: Website forgery: cloned versions of legitimate media and government sites carrying anti-Western content [S2][S5]. Amplification via social media, including advertising, and creation of celebrity images with fake quotes about Ukraine [search summary of S2/S5]. Microsoft's December 2023 report also describes pushing the false claim that Hamas acquired Ukrainian weapons on the black market for the 7 October 2023 attack [S1], and amplifying images of Star of David graffiti in Paris [S3]. Reporting indicates use of generative AI to create news stories, with little organic engagement [search summary of S5]; one count cited by DisinfoLab-adjacent coverage says more than 700 fake websites were created between November 2023 and August 2024 [search result, unverified]. The September 2024 DOJ action described cybersquatted domains mimicking legitimate outlets [S8][S9].

campaigns.name: Pro-Russia influence operations against supporters of Ukraine
campaigns.summary: Start of the activity Microsoft attributes to Storm-1099, including the Doppelganger website-forgery operation.

campaigns.name: Hamas-Ukrainian weapons narrative
campaigns.summary: After the 7 October attack on Israel, Storm-1099 pushed the false claim that Hamas acquired Ukrainian weapons on the black market.

campaigns.name: Paris graffiti amplification
campaigns.summary: Storm-1099 is reported (aggregator profile) to have amplified images of graffiti in Paris, suggesting Russian involvement.

campaigns.name: Microsoft Threat Analysis Center report on Russian influence operations
campaigns.summary: Press coverage of Microsoft's report says Storm-1099 was behind Doppelganger and shifted focus from Western Europe to Israel and the United States. The same report covered Russian celebrity Cameo videos targeting Zelensky; a later Microsoft report attributes the Cameo videos to Storm-1679, not Storm-1099, so do not attribute them to Storm-1099.

campaigns.name: DOJ domain seizures and Treasury sanctions
campaigns.summary: DOJ announced seizure of 32 domains tied to Doppelganger; Treasury designated 10 individuals and two entities over Russian election influence efforts. Government statements name SDA, Structura and ANO Dialog, not Storm-1099.

diamond.adversary: Russia-affiliated influence actor; Doppelganger is linked by DOJ affidavit reporting and DisinfoLab to Social Design Agency and Structura [S3][S5][S9].
diamond.capability: Cloned news and government websites, social media amplification and ads, fabricated celebrity quotes, narrative injection after news events, and reported generative AI content [S1][S2][S5].
diamond.infrastructure: Lookalike and cybersquatted domains (DOJ seized 32 in September 2024), social media accounts and ads [S8][S9]. Full infrastructure detail is not in sources I could open.
diamond.victim: Audiences in Ukraine-supporting countries (Germany, France, US, Israel) and the media brands whose sites were cloned [S1][S5].
diamond.socioPolitical: Russia's war in Ukraine and efforts to erode foreign support; exploitation of the Israel-Hamas conflict and the 2024 US election [S1][S9].
diamond.technology: Open social media platforms, ad systems, domain registration and web hosting; verification of site authenticity by readers is the exposed seam [S5][S8].

gaps: Microsoft's primary December 2023 report (S10) was not retrieved; claims rely on press coverage (S1, S2) and an aggregator profile (S3).
Many specifics (Hamas claim, Paris graffiti) are reported via secondary summaries; verify against the Microsoft original before use.
The DOJ press release (S8) and DFRLab explainer were not opened; DOJ details come from search snippets and press coverage (S7, S9).
Cluster boundaries: Doppelganger, RRN, Matriochka, Overload and Storm-1679 are tracked by different researchers and Microsoft; overlap with Storm-1099 is not established here beyond Doppelganger.
Microsoft's confidence level and whether Storm-1099 was later renamed or graduated are unknown in these sources.
No current-activity data after 2024 gathered; the Doppelganger operation was reported to have resumed after the DOJ action, from a secondary blog only.
No MITRE ATT&CK group record; this is an influence actor with no reported intrusion tradecraft.
Cameo videos: a later Microsoft report (Paris Olympics) attributes them to Storm-1679, described as separate from Storm-1099; the Dec 2023 linkage is unclear.

implications.jipoe: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. STEP 1: Key terrain is the information environment: social platforms, ad systems and the domain and hosting ecosystem used for lookalike sites; audiences are US and allied publics and service members' social media feeds. STEP 2: The actor reacts quickly to news events (the Hamas weapons claim, Paris graffiti) and shifts regions as the focus of conflict shifts [S1][S3]. STEP 3: Template is cloned or lookalike sites plus social amplification and ads, with fabricated quotes or imagery [S2][S5]. STEP 4: MLCOA is continued narrative operations to erode support for Ukraine and sow division around elections, with low organic reach [S1][S5][S9]. MDCOA is a convincing clone of a DoD or allied government site or press release timed to a crisis. Candidate indicators: newly registered domains mimicking media and government sites, unusual ad buys, and sudden coordinated amplification of unattributed claims following a security event [S5][S8].
implications.jcc2: Analyst assessment derived from cited sources; validate before use. (1) Situational awareness: track lookalike domains and narrative spikes tied to events, using public reporting from Microsoft, DisinfoLab and platform disclosures. (2) Authorities: counter-influence response sits largely with civilian agencies and public affairs; DOJ and Treasury actions in 2024 show the law-enforcement path [S7][S9]; check legal limits before any military action online. (3) Mission assurance: influence activity of this kind does not target networks directly in the sources read, so risk is to personnel perception and public affairs credibility, not system integrity. (4) Coordination: engage public affairs, the interagency, platform trust-and-safety contacts and allied partners to report fake sites quickly.

provenance.importedSummary: Storm-1099 is a sophisticated Russia-affiliated influence actor that has been conducting pro-Russia influence operations targeting international supporters of Ukraine since Spring 2022. They are known for their website forgery operation called "Doppelganger" and have been actively spreading false information. They have been involved in pushing the claim that Hamas acquired Ukrainian weapons for an attack on Israel. Storm-1099 has also been implicated in amplifying images of graffiti in Paris, suggesting possible Russian involvement and aligning with Russia's Active Measures playbook.
